recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑間原本應有的造血細胞與脂肪幾乎全被淡粉紅的纖維化間質取代，其中散布深染的小細胞團；低倍就能看出「造血消失＋纖維化＋異質細胞巢」，要想到轉移性癌。
features: Low-power core with irregular bony trabeculae
Intertrabecular marrow largely replaced by pale desmoplastic fibrous stroma
Scattered small hyperchromatic nests and cords of tumor cells within the stroma
Near-complete loss of hematopoietic cells and fat
Focal hemorrhage at the core edge
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by pale desmoplastic fibrous stroma, with near-complete loss of hematopoietic elements and fat. Scattered small hyperchromatic cell nests and cords are present throughout the fibrotic areas. Detailed cytology is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive bone marrow involvement by metastatic carcinoma with desmoplasia, in keeping with the known invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis retains atypical megakaryocyte clusters and hematopoietic cells in the fibrosis, without cohesive epithelial nests.

ddx.dx: Post-chemotherapy or radiation-related marrow fibrosis/stromal damage
ddx.vs: Treatment-related changes show edematous or fibrotic stroma with hypocellularity but no epithelial tumor nests.
Crush artifact produces smeared chromatin streaks rather than well-formed nests within true collagenous stroma.
